description: This file defines a CallGraph class that constructs, manipulates, and visualizes a function call graph based on execution trace data, including handling exceptions and graph compression.

classes.name: CallGraph
classes.description: A class for building, analyzing, compressing, and visualizing a function call graph from execution trace data.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the CallGraph with log data and builds the graph.

methods.name: _build_graph
methods.description: Constructs the call graph from provided log data, handling call and exception events.

methods.name: iterate_graph
methods.description: Iterates through the graph, logging details of each node and its successors.

methods.name: export_for_graphviz
methods.description: Exports the graph in a format compatible with Graphviz.

methods.name: find_node_by_fname
methods.description: Finds nodes corresponding to a given function name.

methods.name: compress_graph
methods.description: Compresses the graph by removing nodes with many children.

methods.name: _remove_descendants
methods.description: Recursively removes a node and its descendants from the graph.

methods.name: _calculate_depths
methods.description: Calculates the depth of each node based on the longest path to leaves.

methods.name: _calculate_descendants
methods.description: Recalculates total number of descendants for each node.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Generates and renders a visual representation of the call graph using Graphviz.
